en.title: Configure AL MCP workspaces dynamically
en.summary: "Start the AL MCP server without a predefined project, add AL projects at runtime, and use configured connection details in headless scenarios without authentication prompts. Business value: AI-agent hosts can start a reusable AL MCP server before the target project is known, then load projects as work begins. This supports flexible agent sessions, shared tooling configurations, and headless automation without requiring a separate server process for every preconfigured workspace."
